subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the Home-first Wear context workflow, including removal of the separate Agent and Session pages and the new `model-controls` companion capability, as the supported paired Phone/Watch experience?
rationale: The implementation has no concrete review finding and includes strong device proof, but choosing the permanent Watch information architecture and independently versioned companion behavior is a maintainer product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept the Home-first workflow
options.body: Approve the additive capability-gated protocol and page consolidation once required Android checks complete on the reviewed head.

options.title: Keep dedicated context pages
options.body: Retain the existing Watch pager architecture and close or narrow the PR rather than adopting the new Home controls.

recommendation.title: Accept the Home-first workflow
recommendation.body: Approve the additive capability-gated protocol and page consolidation once required Android checks complete on the reviewed head.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to steipete, who also authored the branch’s later Wear compatibility hardening.
